normalization: No split synonym entries; packet positions equal normalized positions.
surfactantArchitecture: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2, defining, ether type); Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3, hydrotrope, not a route); Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4) buffer; TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (18) after Parfum, recorded but not a route (C4).

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic is ether/sulfonate type with at least one prominent buffer and no prominent reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate. SLES (2) buffered by CAPB (4); TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (18) is not prominent.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Silicone/guar conditioning; hydrotrope. No move from convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful system: silicone/guar coacervate (Dimethiconol 10, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride 11, Dimethicone 14), all after Parfum; Panthenol (19) late. C2 not met (silicone not early, no pearlizer, no prominent humectant) -> moderate.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: All conditioning after the fragrance marker; low is a realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: a silicone-plus-cationic-guar deposition system (designed coacervate) plausibly leaves bounded, persistent residue, against an effective C1 reset.

depositionLoad.rationale: Two silicones (10, 14) with a cationic guar (11): one coherent depositing system, all post-fragrance.

persistence.rationale: Dimethicone/dimethiconol are water-insoluble and can accumulate; guar aids deposition.

weightPotential.counterSignal: Every depositing ingredient is after Parfum; levels may be small enough for low.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone plus cationic guar is a plausibly persistent depositing system; calling it lightweight would understate residue risk.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: silicone + guar is a real, persistent deposition system and two families converge (W2). Not high: no W-RICH (no payload lipid), no second polymer or film former, effective reset. W1 not cited (no amodimethicone; set incomplete).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone levels unknown; low is the realistic neighbor.

focusPrimary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). Dandruff active prominent; scalp_active compatible if dandruff positioning appears.

careDirection.basis: Silicone/guar conditioning distinguishes neither repair nor moisture; no humectant cluster.

focusSecondary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). Empty default; a secondary needs distinct positioning (Section 8), not visible yet.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). Default regular (Section 9); triggers need graded claims. treatment possible with a qualifying dandruff claim.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). SC1 positioning not visible. CSA formula half: fails: no prominent E4 comfort or humectant route (Panthenol 19, Niacinamide 30 after Parfum).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine (position 6), a recognized anti-dandruff active (Section 11). Formula-only; whether a dandruff target projects depends on a dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
dandruffSupport.counterSignal: None for the formula fact; positioning not yet visible.
